BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS

FIG. 1 is a flowchart of a method of generating an alert from sensor data.
FIGS. 3A to 3C together are a flowchart of an order fulfillment method.
FIG. 6 shows a settings screen.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION

Referring to FIG. 1, at step 102 the method receives sensor data. At step 104
the data is filtered. Decision 106 compares each value with a limit. Step 108
generates an alert, which a server 120 forwards to a phone 122.

In FIG. 3A, steps 302, 304, 306, 308 and 310 receive, verify, reserve, pick
and pack an order. Filed 2026-10-04; see claim 7 and [0042].
